prompt: Nurse: "Hello Bilal, this is the Amman clinic. Have you eaten anything before your morning blood test?" answer_text: Nurse: "Hello Bilal, this is the Amman clinic. Have you eaten anything before your morning blood test?" prompt: Did you read Mr Kowalski's notice that the water in our Warsaw flat will be off next Tuesday morning? In that case, I {{1:to fill}} a few large bottles on Monday evening.
